# BioLongevity Labs
> USA-made, third-party tested research-grade peptides and bioregulators for laboratory and scientific investigation.

BioLongevity Labs supplies high-purity research compounds including BPC-157, TB-500, epitalon, thymulin, and bioregulator capsules with certificates of analysis. Products are for research use only (RUO), not for human or veterinary administration.
